notes: v1.45 — the schedule pull now captures ALL providers on the athenaOne Day view (coordinate-based reader), cleans provider names, and reads the schedule date. NEW: config-driven — the extension fetches its Athena selectors from mlsscribe.com/mls-assist-config.json, so future Athena changes can be fixed on the site without a Chrome Web Store update. Falls back to built-in defaults if the config is unavailable. Installable: MLS_Assist_v1.45.zip.
